description: This file defines a TypeScript module for a DELETE request tool, including schema creation, class implementation, and request handling logic.

classes.name: RequestsDeleteTool
classes.description: A class extending DynamicStructuredTool to perform DELETE HTTP requests with dynamic URL and query parameter handling.

methods.name: createRequestsDeleteSchema
methods.description: Creates a Zod schema for DELETE request query parameters based on an optional JSON schema string.

methods.name: _call
methods.description: Executes the DELETE request with URL and query parameters, handling path and query parameter substitution.
